scripts.build-img: if not exist wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\img mkdir wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\img && xcopy /E /I /Y wordpress\wp-content\themes\src\img\* wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\img\
scripts.build-video: if not exist wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\video mkdir wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\video && xcopy /E /I /Y wordpress\wp-content\themes\src\video\* wordpress\wp-content\themes\theme-geoplast\assets\video\
scripts.build: npm run build-img && npm run build-video && npm run build-sass
